messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — Sunnyside reported duplicate session generations and duplicate billing when they reconnect after a brief network blip. Happened multiple times today, they're on a paid trial. cc @Carlos (PM) @Anjali (Eng)

Carlos (PM): Thanks Maya. Can you paste repro steps + any logs/trace IDs? How many users affected?

Maya (CS): Repro steps I used (all on hosted: api.redwood.ai, us-west-2):
1) Start a chat with session_id=sess-7f2 using web SDK v0.9.2
2) Send "hello" -> server returns generation r1
3) Kill client connection (ctrl+c / network drop) immediately after receiving r1
4) Reconnect within ~20s and send "continue" with the same session_id
5) Server returns a new generation and billing occurs again. User sees duplicated history entry. Reproduced locally with their quickstart.

Logs (sanitized):
```
[2025-11-02T14:22:03Z] trace=tr_8a9 recv request sess-7f2
[2025-11-02T14:22:03Z] trace=tr_8a9 resumed kvcache hit=false
[2025-11-02T14:22:04Z] trace=tr_8a9 generating tokens=120 cost=0.024
[2025-11-02T14:22:05Z] trace=tr_8a9 billing record created billing_id=bill_54321 dup=false
[2025-11-02T14:22:06Z] trace=tr_8a9 connection reset by client
[2025-11-02T14:22:10Z] trace=tr_9b0 new request sess-7f2 generating tokens=118 billing_id=bill_54322 dup=true
```

Maya (CS): Affected ~2 users at Sunnyside, and CS reproduced 3x. Repro repo (internal): https://git.company/sunnyside/repro

Anjali (Eng): Thanks. Can you confirm: hosted vs dedicated? Which model? Do you have full traces for tr_8a9 and tr_9b0? Assigning to eng-oncall to triage. @Liam any initial thoughts?

Maya (CS): Hosted (api.redwood.ai, us-west-2). Model rdw-std-13b. Traces: tr_8a9..., tr_9b0... (linked in ticket). SDK: web SDK v0.9.2 (websocket fallback).

Liam (SRE): My quick read: KV cache shows hit=false on resume, so the runtime is re-generating. If we don't guard resume with an idempotency/in-flight marker, we may double-bill. Need to check resume path and billing dedupe. Also confirm client is not resending same request with different idempotency keys.

Maya (CS): Client not sending dedupe keys, just resending same session id. They expect server to treat reconnect+continue as continuation, not a brand-new generation.

dev-bot: Ticket created: CS-5421 Sunnyside duplicate billing on session resume — https://tickets.redwood.ai/CS-5421

Anjali (Eng): Triage notes: I reproduced with the repro app on hosted. Hypothesis: resume path doesn't check "in-flight" or recent completion markers and allows a new generate to run which triggers a second billing entry. Plan: add resume idempotency check keyed on session_id + last_event_seq or last_event_ts. Add unit + integration tests, and ensure billing write is guarded by idempotency token. Will open PR and canary.

Carlos (PM): This looks like P1. Customer is evaluating on paid trial and may pause if unresolved. Roadmap ask: prioritize for next sprint. Release criteria: prevents duplicate billing on resume, passes integration tests, no latency regression, can be rolled back. Also want an ops feature flag for controlled rollout.

Anjali (Eng): Agreed on criteria. Acceptance criteria Ilya/Eng requires: (1) repro before fix, (2) fix merged + tests, (3) canary at 5% hosted traffic for 24h, (4) 95p latency not increased by >10ms, (5) billing dedupe verified in logs for traced requests. I'll create ENG-9987 and assign to @Anjali and @Ravi. ETA: 3 days for patch + tests, 2 days for canary verification.

Carlos (PM): Add to sprint board and notify product comms + CS playbook for customer messaging.

Maya (CS): I'll update Sunnyside with ticket link and repro steps. They requested a rollback path if canary shows issues.

Anjali (Eng): Assigned ENG-9987 -> owners Anjali, Ravi. I'll post progress to #eng-oncall.

Maya (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the customer and confirm when the fix is canaried.
